          Modal-lightbox

          The lightbox is the modal family's viewer: it shows a thing rather than asking a question. Dialog mechanics are inherited from Modals — trapped focus, Escape, inert background, focus return — plus previous/next navigation with arrow keys and a captioned stage.

          March statement — page 1: account summary.

          1 of 3

          Popover

          A popover opens on activation and can hold focusable content — Tooltip's interactive sibling. It flips above/below the trigger, clamps to the viewport, and closes on Escape, outside click, or toggling the trigger. Focus is not trapped: it is a non-modal dialog.
